verdict.rationale: Shortwave's AI assistant can check your calendar and write drafts, and the AI connects to Calendar. That implies it could draft a reply listing your free times, but no evidence explicitly describes inserting availability or bookable slots into an email. Missing for 10: an explicit share-availability or insert-times feature, bookable meeting links or scheduling slots in the composer, dedicated documentation of the workflow, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
